messages:
olivia: Quick thread to lock down the benchmark creative + claims for next week's bench push. goal: clear engineer hook + a biz-friendly variant.
sam: Proposal: two social tiles + one long-form landing. social A = latency-first, social B = cost-first. landing merges both with method appendix.
ravi: Agreed. For the latency tile let's call out p95 at 512 tokens. Don't bury that in small type.
lee: For cost tile, use 'tokens per $' normalized to 100k tokens so the numbers are readable. avoid % reductions in hero unless we can prove them across all configs.
olivia: Method footnote draft (short):
```
Method: workloads synthesized from Prod token-length histogram. Tests run on same instance type, batching toggled per run. Cost estimated from public on-demand GPU pricing; results normalized to 100k tokens. See full benchmark link on landing.
```
maria: Can we get a quick table of sample sizes? want at least 1k inference calls per prompt length bucket (32/128/512).
ravi: will do. also include cold vs warm KV cache rows. those change p95 a lot.
sam: Design asks: one PNG for docs (grid of 3 small charts + table), one simplified JPG for socials (big number + single chart).
lee: Copy options:
- Eng: "Same p95, far lower cost — see our micro-benchmark."
- Biz: "Reduce inference spend while keeping customer latency fast."
olivia: Add an 'explainers' microcopy under chart: "Lower is better" or "Higher is better" depending on metric. tiny UX win.
maria: Legal: avoid absolutes. legal-bot, can you confirm safe phrasing for homepage hero claims?
legal-bot: Suggestion: use language like "up to" or "in our tests" and link to methodology. Avoid blanket statements like "always" or "guaranteed."
lee: For ad tracking, include creative=latency|cost and audience=eng|pm in UTM.
olivia: Landing variants: V1 = big latency stat above fold + CTA Book a demo. V2 = cost savings stat above fold + CTA Download bench. We'll send half traffic to each.
sam: Measurement: primary KPI = demo conversions for V1, gated doc downloads + nurture CTR for V2. Secondary = CTR on creative. Collect cohort of demo leads and track downstream engagement for 30 days.
ravi: I'll run the microtest Wednesday 00:00 UTC for 48 hours. will push raw CSV to /shared/bench-results and a summarized PNG.
maria: Who's owning the landing? lee?
lee: I'll spin up two variants in Webflow, wire UTMs, and add event hooks. need final copy by EOD Tuesday.
olivia: Content owners: ravi (bench data + PNG), lee (landing + UTMs), sam (creative + social copy), maria (distribution + claim sign-off). legal-bot will review copy before launch.
legal-bot: I'll review within 24h of copy ping. please include explicit method link in landing footer.
maria: Timeline recap: bench run Wed-Thu, first creative drafts Wed afternoon, legal review Thurs morning, landing live Fri AM staging, soft launch next Mon.
sam: Also recommend a short livestream demo (30m) showing how we measure and how customers can reproduce results. schedule if leads are high.
olivia: Great. Ravi post first data dump here when ready and we'll iterate copy after seeing numbers. :sparkles:
